core_obligations: Reduce to a globally generated ideal via localization
Rewrite derived completion by Koszul complexes
Exchange Rf_* with Rlim and apply the projection formula

proof_roadmap.step: Use Proposition derived-completion and Lemma pushforward-derived-complete for the canonical map
Apply Lemma derived-completion-koszul to pass to the Koszul display
Conclude via the projection formula and Lf^* of the Koszul complex

difficulty_reason: The retained proof is a full computation: existence of derived completion via the named proposition, the canonical map by universal property, localization to a globally generated ideal, replacement by Koszul complexes via Lemma derived-completion-koszul, commuting Rf_* with Rlim by the sites lemma, and the final equality by the projection formula plus the explicit identity Lf^*K(I) = K(I'). Retained author proof at lines 1738-1774.
